reviews.title: SCAM ⚠️
reviews.text:
I had a terrible experience with Astroline. The app is extremely misleading. It feels like you can be charged simply by clicking through the app, without clearly and knowingly agreeing to a payment or subscription.

What’s even more disappointing is that they don’t actually provide meaningful astrology information for what you are being charged for. I was charged without my clear permission and have been trying to get a refund.

I strongly recommend staying away from this app and being extremely careful before clicking anything or entering payment details.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I love horoscopes and astrology, and I even read tarot myself, so I was genuinely excited to try this app. I signed up for the free trial but canceled it before it renewed. Despite that, my card continued to be charged. I contacted support multiple times and kept receiving the same generic response, with no real help or acknowledgment of the issue. I wasn’t able to recover the money I didn’t realize was still being taken. Eventually I had to file a claim with my bank because the charges kept adding up with no help. As a college student, this was especially stressful and disappointing. The situation ultimately ended with me having to push just to get my account fully deleted. I’m very upset with how this was handled and with the lack of support from the company.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: If you believe in this stuff or not this app and company is a scam. I got the $1 trial and didn’t like it. Eventually I thought I canceled it but I guess it hit the wrong button (they try really hard to get you to make a mistake when try to cancel) and didn’t actually cancel. So, I got charged a week later without knowing. As soon as I saw the charge I emailed the support team and they said there was nothing they could do since I agreed to the terms and conditions. A mistake by me turns a profit to them and they don’t care how they do it.

reviews.title: Do not do the trial ! Scam!
reviews.text:
I signed up for a trial on Monday and cancelled later that same evening, well within the trial period. During the cancellation process, I received a confirmation screen indicating the cancellation was complete.

Despite this, I was charged for a full subscription days later. Only after being charged did I discover there was a supposed “second step” to the cancellation via email, which was never clearly disclosed during the cancellation process. The email itself looked more like a generic cancellation notice than a required action.

This feels intentionally misleading and like a dark-pattern cancellation process. I provided proof of the cancellation confirmation screen, yet was still charged. Very disappointing experience—be cautious if you sign up for a trial.

reviews.title: Just okay.
reviews.text:
Paid for the subscription and the 3 pack deal readings. Liked it but it’s expensive overall and a lot of features need to be paid as well in app on top of paying a subscription. Don’t get me wrong there is plenty of content it’s just most content I wanted needs to be paid to unlock as well. I decided to cancel my subscription early. I was asked if I want to stay for a discounted price I agreed, and was charged again at that time even though my current subscription was technically still active. I canceled the new subscription because I didn’t know I was going to be charged (which they made clear in an email was my fault) and they ended my subscription I just paid for early as well even though I should still be able to access the benefits of the plan until it was expired but it was ended early all together. 
I wanted to love this so badly, but for those reasons I don’t recommend the app.
I prefer chani for my astrology.
